# DropSpace 1.1 Beta7

<!-- update-summary: Browse concise release highlights from the About logo in the Island or on the website. -->

- Click the About logo to browse the Island’s release history, five versions at a time.
- The Island follows your update channel. The website also shows a short summary for each release.
- Fixed lyrics falling behind or jumping back during Apple Music playback.
- Clipboard history now quietly retries brief clipboard locks.

v1.1.0-beta.6 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release.
